data.text: Implementation is on fix/metrics-trace-capture; user authorized one shared PR. Repository inspection found the existing test-support/dispatch.rs workaround (OFF-filtered sentinel with bootstrap regression), so metrics ordering now reuses that constructor rather than adding another sentinel. Both original ordering assertions are exercised in fresh child processes after subscriber-less first touch. A mutation bypassing the constructor failed both at the expected missing WARN/INFO assertions; the initial fixed metrics suite passed 31 tests. Existing destructor-panic assertions remain. No production API/dependency changes. Full verify.sh is running; its initial Clippy pass rejected a new private boolean argument under the repository zero-boolean-parameter policy. Replaced it with CaptureDestruction and restarted verification; no lint relaxation.

Delivered together in https://github.com/bpcakes/batter/pull/69 (ready for review, not merged), commit ae9e7e9 on fix/metrics-trace-capture. The metrics suite now uses the existing shared OFF-filtered sentinel dispatcher constructor for all capture subscribers. Two bounded fresh-process tests force subscriber-less first registration of cleanup WARN/INFO callsites and then run the existing ordering/count assertions. The original destructor-panic case is preserved. No production code, public API or dependency graph changed; Cargo.lock is unchanged.

Final-tree validation on Linux x86_64, pinned Rust 1.98.1: bash scripts/verify.sh passed in full (formatting, file budgets, all four Clippy configurations, all six test-matrix parts, rustdoc, every HTTP smoke profile). Workspace tests passed in 500.804s, including native PostgreSQL tests; full log /tmp/batter-metrics-verify.log. The workspace-unified metrics-3c9b15f828842f5e binary passed all 31 tests in 100/100 fresh-process --test-threads=32 runs alongside native database verification; /tmp/batter-metrics-fixed-stress.log. Bypassing the shared constructor made both new isolated tests fail at the original missing-WARN/INFO assertions; /tmp/batter-metrics-cold-mutation.log. The first verification attempt caught the new private boolean argument under Clippy; replaced with CaptureDestruction before the successful full run. No lint or semantic assertion relaxed. No local MSRV or macOS run; hosted CI remains separately observable on the PR. One PR repairs both reported manifestations; tracker closure records completed implementation and local validation, not merge or publication.
